WITH 
  round1 AS (
    SELECT 
      "District", 
      "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS literacy
    FROM 
      "district_health_factsheet"
    WHERE 
      "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
  ),
  round2 AS (
    SELECT 
      "District", 
      "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS literacy
    FROM 
      "district_health_factsheet"
    WHERE 
      "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
  )
SELECT 
  "District"
FROM 
  round1
JOIN 
  round2 ON "District" = round2."District"
WHERE 
  literacy IS NOT NULL AND 
  literacy > (SELECT literacy FROM round1 WHERE "District" = round2."District")
